behavior: The child gets a pty when the parent has a terminal, and a pipe when it does not
A secret routed through the pty is redacted before reaching the parent's stdout, including when split across two of the child's writes
The hold-back is prefix-aware: a frame whose tail is not a proper prefix of any secret is released on the write, not withheld until the next one
The #1459 introspection guard runs on the pty path too, so the new branch is not a second way to dump the environment
The Windows build keeps the pipe path and compiles clean
